project_name: SonicGo - Sonic Chicken Internal F&B ERP
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / CORPORATE F&B HIGH-DENSITY
theme: Clean corporate dashboard with warm crimson red branding (#DC2626 / #B91C1C) for Sonic Chicken fried chicken business

layout_and_spacing.mode: MODE B - High Density ERP Grid with Touch-Optimized Tablet Controls
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed responsive sidebar with mobile sheet drawer; includes multi-branch switcher, user role status, language switcher (ID/EN)
layout_and_spacing.header: Sticky header with z-50, backdrop-blur-md, search bar, active branch badge, shift indicator, quick action buttons, notification drawer for low stock / debt alerts
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards and dialogs, rounded-lg for input buttons

modules_and_pages.title: Dashboard Operations
components: KPI Cards: Total Sales (Rp), Total Expenses (Rp), Cash Flow Balance (Rp), Food Cost % (Target vs Actual)
Channel Breakdown Chart (Reguler/Dine-In, GrabFood, GoFood, ShopeeFood) with commission deductions
Recent Sales Activity Stream & Quick Input Shortcut
Low Stock Alerts & Spoilage Summary Banner

modules_and_pages.title: Sales Entry & Register
components: Channel Dropdown (Reguler/Dine-In, GrabFood, GoFood, ShopeeFood)
Itemized Order Selection (Ayam Goreng Crispy, Paket Ayam Geprek, Wings, Es Teh, Air Mineral)
Automatic Channel Commission & Net Revenue Calculation (e.g. Grab 20%, GoFood 20%, Shopee 20%)
Payment Method (Cash, QRIS, Bank Transfer, EDC Debit/Credit)
Quick Tablet Numpad & Receipt Generation Modal

modules_and_pages.title: Expenses & Credit Purchases
components: Type Switcher: Petty Cash Expenses vs Credit Vendor Purchases (Hutang)
Vendor Selection Dropdown (PT Ayam Broiler Utama, CV Bumbu Rempah Nusantara, Toko Minyak Resto)
Category Picker (Raw Materials, Operational/Utilities, Packaging, Maintenance, Marketing)
Receipt / Invoice Attachment Dropzone simulation
Due Date Selector for Vendor Credit Purchases

modules_and_pages.title: Inventory & Spoilage Management
components: Stock Count Matrix (Weekly / Monthly Physical vs System Count)
Leftover & Spoilage Log Form (Reason: Expired, Burnt, Dropped, Shift Discrepancy)
TO-TI Inter-Branch Transfer Form (Branch Source -> Branch Target with Transfer Status)
Minimum Reorder Level Indicator & Stock Adjustment Log

modules_and_pages.title: Vendor Debt Tracking (Hutang Vendor)
components: Vendor Summary Cards (Total Hutang Aktif, Due This Week, Overdue Balance)
Vendor Debt Table with Payment Log Modal
Record Partial / Full Payment Action with Petty Cash or Bank Account deducted

modules_and_pages.title: Financial & Operational Reports
components: Date Range Filter Picker (Hari Ini, 7 Hari Terakhir, Bulan Ini, Custom Range)
Cash Report per Period & Cash Flow Ledger
Food Cost % Variance & Profitability Breakdown
Export to Excel / PDF instant action buttons with feedback toast

modules_and_pages.title: User Roles & Multi-Branch Control
components: Role Permissions Matrix (Super Admin vs User Keuangan / Staff Toko)
Branch Management (Sudirman, Kemang, Bandung, Surabaya)
Language Toggle (Bahasa Indonesia / English) with full reactive UI translation

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: All buttons, inputs, dropdowns, table rows, tab triggers, modal toggles, language switches, and KPI metric cards MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='sales-channel-select', data-testid='kpi-total-sales-value', data-testid='lang-toggle-id').
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height for interactive buttons and input fields to support tablet usage in kitchen/cashier environments.
accessibility_and_testing.hover_contrast: Always explicit hover styles with contrast check: hover:bg-red-700 hover:text-white or hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure language state (ID/EN) is globally managed and toggles all UI strings across Dashboard, Sales, Expenses, Inventory, Vendor Debt, Reports, and Auth.
Ensure multi-branch state is reactive, filtering metrics and tables by selected branch or 'All Branches'.
Implement realistic calculation logic for Food Cost % = (Beginning Inventory + Purchases - Ending Inventory) / Food Sales * 100.
Support toast notifications via Sonner for key actions like saving sales, submitting stock transfer, recording debt payment, and exporting report.
Use JetBrains Mono for monetary values (Rp), transaction IDs, and quantities to ensure clear tabular alignment.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow high density tablet-friendly ERP principles. Avoid centered slop, use dark crimson red accents with high legibility neutral backgrounds, micro-animations on table rows and action triggers, explicit contrast on focus/hover, and sonner toast feedback.
